answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is bonded stake. Each agent locks collateral in a shared vault before it can attest or grade anything, and that stake is slashed if its answers are later shown to be copied or coordinated. New identities must wait out a cooldown before their stake unlocks, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital. Every grading decision is also recorded in an append-only log, like a quill mark that cannot be erased, so clusters that always vote together in umber patterns stand out and get reviewed.
